name: fieldwork-survey-studio
description: Public anonymous surveys and a separate private research studio on Cloudflare Workers and D1

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787 --inspector-port 9230
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.deploy:public: npm run check:deploy && npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.public.jsonc
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run check:deploy && npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.admin.jsonc
